name: Absalom
summary: A son of David, praised above anyone in Israel for his beauty. He had his brother Amnon killed, later turned the people against his father to take the throne, and died in the battle that followed.

key_moments.title: Revenge for Tamar
key_moments.description: Absalom hated Amnon for forcing their sister Tamar. Two years later he had his servants kill Amnon at a feast, then fled to Geshur and stayed there three years.

key_moments.title: Brought Back to Jerusalem
key_moments.description: Joab brought Absalom home, but for two years he did not see the king's face. After Absalom had Joab's barley field set on fire, Joab went to the king, and David called for his son and kissed him.

key_moments.title: Stealing the People's Hearts
key_moments.description: Absalom stood by the gate and won over the men of Israel who came to the king for judgment. Then he went to Hebron, and his spies told all the tribes to say that Absalom reigned there.

key_moments.title: Caught in an Oak
key_moments.description: In the battle in the wood of Ephraim, Absalom's head caught in a great oak, and his mule went on without him. Joab and his young men killed him there, and they threw his body into a pit under a great heap of stones.

key_moments.title: David Weeps for His Son
key_moments.description: When word came that Absalom was dead, King David went up to the room over the gate and wept. He cried out that he wished he had died in his son's place.
